## Clef (System One) API

Clef (System One) is a decision model by Clef, available on the Venice API as `clef-api`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Clef (System One) is Cloudflare's decision model. Like Jev, it answers typed questions about a passage with structured judgments rather than prose: probabilities, choices or rubric scores. It reads up to 32,768 tokens of context.

### Clef (System One) API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clef-api` | Standard | Private | $0.05 / $0.05 per 1M |

### Clef (System One) specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Clef |
| Released | Oct 6, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Beta |

### How to use the Clef (System One) API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/decisions` with `"model": "clef-api"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/decisions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "clef-api",
    "state": "Help! My payouts have been failing for 3 days.",
    "questions": {
      "is_urgent": { "type": "noul", "instructions": "Does this need a reply within the hour?" }
    }
  }'
```
